catalog.purpose: Reference cases for applying DDD for Acting Systems to SAP-heavy enterprise decisions. They are patterns for analysis, not product configuration instructions.

examples.title: Sales: delivery risk response
examples.summary: Use AI to explain and rank valid responses when a customer promise is at risk, while SAP availability and order state remain authoritative.

decision_card.business_outcome: Keep a credible customer promise while reacting quickly to fulfillment risk.

authoritative_inputs: SAP S/4HANA sales order and schedule-line state
delivery execution status when a delivery exists
truth.freshness_rule: Re-read current order state and availability before a material promise change.
invariants: Do not invent available quantity or dates.
Do not bypass sales-order authorization or document consistency checks.

allowed: Explain why the promise is at risk.
Rank alternatives that are returned by valid domain services.
Prepare a proposed promise change for review.
forbidden: Change customer promise only because an API is callable.
judgment.design_posture_reason: The case has useful ambiguity, but the customer promise is a material commitment and current state can change quickly.

authority.scope: Named sales organizations, order types and approved exception scenarios.
authority.frequency_limit: Prepare proposals without execution limit; execution remains separately authorized.
authority.time_window: Proposal is valid only while referenced order and ATP versions remain current.
authority.delegation_rule: A delegated task may read or analyze narrower data but cannot receive promise-change authority.

preconditions: Current ATP or aATP evidence is valid.
Required authorization and process checks pass.
commitment.idempotency_or_duplicate_control: Use document version and change request identity to avoid duplicate updates.
commitment.reversal_or_compensation: Create a controlled follow-up change and customer communication if the new promise must be corrected.

retain: ATP or aATP result and calculation time
evidence.outcome_observation: Compare the changed promise with later delivery execution and customer-impact outcome.
evidence.sensitive_data_notes: Avoid storing unnecessary customer personal data in model or telemetry traces.

cases: Shortage with one valid alternative plant.
Shortage where no valid alternative exists.
Order state changes after the recommendation but before execution.
Conflicting transport and ATP signals.
evaluation.promotion_gate: Increase autonomy only after stale-state handling, false alternatives and customer-impact cases meet agreed acceptance criteria.

decision_card.notes: Good example of why a recommendation and a commitment need separate boundaries.

examples.title: Procurement: source selection exception
examples.summary: Use AI to compare approved sourcing options when several suppliers or agreements are valid, but keep release strategy and purchasing commitments deterministic.

decision_card.business_outcome: Choose a valid source quickly without creating an uncontrolled purchasing commitment.

authoritative_inputs: approved source list or sourcing master data
purchasing info records and valid conditions
truth.freshness_rule: Validate source validity, purchasing conditions and requisition state before creating or changing a purchasing document.
invariants: Do not select a blocked or invalid source.
Do not bypass mandatory release or approval strategy.

allowed: Rank valid sources using agreed business factors.
Explain trade-offs between lead time, price and supplier performance.
Prepare a source assignment or purchase-order proposal.
forbidden: Use an unapproved supplier because historical text recommends it.
judgment.design_posture_reason: Several valid options may exist, but creating a purchase order is a financial and supply commitment.

authority.scope: Approved material groups, plants and sourcing scenarios.
authority.value_limit: No autonomous PO release or value increase.
authority.frequency_limit: Proposal generation is unrestricted within workload controls.
authority.time_window: Recommendation expires when source validity, price, requisition or supplier status changes.
authority.delegation_rule: Remote sourcing analysis may receive read access only unless purchasing authority is explicitly delegated.

preconditions: Chosen source is valid and approved.
commitment.idempotency_or_duplicate_control: Reference the originating requisition and proposal identity to prevent duplicate purchasing commitments.
commitment.reversal_or_compensation: Change or cancel the PO through the controlled purchasing process when allowed.

evidence.outcome_observation: Compare selected source with actual confirmation, delivery and supplier-performance outcome.
evidence.sensitive_data_notes: Commercial conditions may be sensitive and should not be copied into broad semantic memory without access control.

cases: Two valid suppliers with different lead time and price.
Preferred supplier becomes blocked after recommendation.
Quota arrangement conflicts with a historical performance preference.
No approved source is valid.
evaluation.promotion_gate: Autonomy can increase only for low-value, reversible, policy-defined cases with strong source validity checks.

decision_card.notes: The AI contribution is ranking and explanation, not purchasing authority.

examples.title: Sales and Finance: credit block response
examples.summary: Use AI to assemble evidence and recommend next action for a credit-blocked order, while credit policy and release authority remain explicit.

decision_card.business_outcome: Resolve blocked orders quickly without weakening credit governance.

truth.freshness_rule: Recalculate or re-read current exposure and block state before release.
invariants: Do not rewrite the credit limit through recommendation logic.
Do not release when mandatory policy conditions fail.

allowed: Summarize the reason for the block.
Explain which evidence supports release, rejection or escalation.
forbidden: Grant credit authority based on model confidence.
Treat sales urgency as a replacement for credit policy.
judgment.design_posture_reason: The decision is high impact and may be hard to reverse, so AI should support the authorized credit role rather than execute by default.

authority.scope: Credit cases visible to the assigned credit role.
authority.time_window: Recommendation is valid only for the exposure snapshot and block state referenced in the evidence.
authority.delegation_rule: Analysis tasks may not inherit credit-release authority.

commitment.idempotency_or_duplicate_control: Use current block state and release action identity.
commitment.reversal_or_compensation: Re-block or apply follow-up credit controls where process rules permit, but treat customer exposure as already affected.

evidence.outcome_observation: Track later exposure, overdue payment and exception outcome for evaluation.
evidence.sensitive_data_notes: Credit and payment information requires restricted access and careful telemetry design.

cases: Exposure just below limit after payment update.
Exposure changes between analysis and release.
High-value strategic order with weak payment history.
Policy requires escalation regardless of model recommendation.
evaluation.promotion_gate: Keep execution human-authorized unless policy defines a narrow low-risk class with deterministic release conditions.

decision_card.notes: A strong case for AI evidence assembly without autonomous commitment.

examples.title: Master Data: material change proposal
examples.summary: Use AI to detect inconsistencies and prepare a governed master-data change, while validation, workflow and activation remain controlled.

decision_card.business_outcome: Improve master-data quality without turning inferred values into authoritative data.

authoritative_inputs: active change request state when governance workflow is used
truth.freshness_rule: Validate the current master record and open governance workflow before proposing or activating a change.
invariants: Do not activate inferred values without required validation.
Do not bypass field ownership or governance workflow.

allowed: Extract candidate values from approved source documents.
Prepare a structured change request with provenance.
forbidden: Activate master data outside the governance path.
judgment.design_posture_reason: AI is useful for extraction and comparison, but master data becomes shared enterprise truth only after controlled validation.

authority.scope: Approved fields, material types and source-document classes.
authority.frequency_limit: Bulk proposal creation is allowed within workflow and review capacity.
authority.time_window: Proposal is linked to the source document and current master-data version.
authority.delegation_rule: Extraction tasks may receive document scope only, never activation authority.

commitment.transactional_system: SAP MDG or governed SAP S/4HANA master-data process
preconditions: Field owners or workflow approvers accept the change.
Current object and change-request versions match.
commitment.idempotency_or_duplicate_control: Use change-request identity and object version.
commitment.reversal_or_compensation: Create a governed correction or rollback change request where supported.

evidence.outcome_observation: Track correction rate, rejected proposals and downstream issue reduction.
evidence.sensitive_data_notes: Respect document classification and field-level access restrictions.

cases: Clear value in one approved specification.
Two source documents disagree.
Similar materials suggest a value not present in the source.
Master record changes while the proposal is under review.
evaluation.promotion_gate: Automation may expand for fields with high extraction precision and deterministic validation, but activation remains separately governed.

decision_card.notes: This case separates semantic extraction from authoritative master-data commitment.

examples.title: Warehouse: execution exception response
examples.summary: Use AI to explain and rank recovery actions for a warehouse exception, while stock, warehouse-task state and execution commands remain authoritative.

decision_card.business_outcome: Recover warehouse flow quickly without corrupting stock or execution state.

truth.freshness_rule: Re-read affected task, stock and handling-unit state immediately before an execution command.
invariants: Do not create impossible stock movement.
Do not confirm a warehouse task that is no longer executable.

allowed: Prepare a warehouse action for review or bounded execution.
forbidden: Ignore current HU or task state because a historical case looks similar.
judgment.design_posture_reason: Some low-risk warehouse recovery actions are high-volume and reversible, but only after deterministic state checks and narrow scope controls.

authority.scope: Named warehouse, exception type, queue and low-risk recovery command.
authority.value_limit: No inventory write-off, ownership change or high-impact stock adjustment.
authority.frequency_limit: Rate-limited by exception type and resource.
authority.time_window: Authority applies only while the referenced execution state is current.
authority.delegation_rule: Diagnostic sub-tasks remain read-only; execution authority is not delegated by default.

preconditions: Current warehouse task and stock state are valid.
Recovery action is allowed for the exception class.
Required approval or bounded policy is present.
commitment.idempotency_or_duplicate_control: Reference exception identity, task state and command id.
commitment.reversal_or_compensation: Cancel or reverse the recovery action using the defined warehouse process when possible.

evidence.outcome_observation: Measure recovery success, repeat exception rate and any follow-up stock correction.
evidence.sensitive_data_notes: Operational traces should avoid unnecessary worker-identifying data.

cases: Recoverable task sequencing issue.
HU state changes before action.
Historical recovery action is no longer allowed by current process rules.
Exception requires stock adjustment and must escalate.
evaluation.promotion_gate: Move from A3 to A4 only for named reversible actions with strong state validation and stable exception classification.

decision_card.notes: Warehouse exceptions show where bounded execution can become realistic when state checks and reversibility are strong.
